body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Toshiba introduced its 2008 REGZA CV510 Series for TV and gaming during CES 2008.
For TV and gaming enthusiasts, the premium REGZA CV510 Series is available in 32- and 37-inch sizes with 720p resolution and enhanced picture quality.

This REGZA series features Toshiba’s PixelPure 4G™ 14-bit Internal Digital Video Processor, which assures smoother, cleaner images with 4,096 levels of gradation, and a new 1.5-inch ThinLine Bezel Design with the thin SoundStrip® speaker system.

Also incorporated is the new Gaming Mode providing more direct video signal-to-the-screen for faster game controller response and 3 HDMI 1.3 inputs with REGZA Link (HDMI CEC) for easy connection to an HD DVD player or other A/V component.
